0.description: When you start the game, the start menu will open. The main menu will appear after opening the start menu. The main menu has Audition mode and Contact mode, but in the first level you can only play Audition mode. Interview girls in audition mode, and once 3 girls pass, the live performance will begin. If the girl you pass is a pure girl, you can get a lot of experience points, so you need to ask questions to the girl during the interview and find out. Gaining experience points and increasing your level will increase the actions you can perform during the interview. Once you reach level 5, you will be able to select contact mode. In contact mode, you can call girls you have passed in the past and perform naughty actions with them. All elements will be unlocked at level 20.
